narrative.overview: The approved direction is Apple TV–inspired: artwork leads, white type stays readable from the couch, and directional focus is explicit. Three native layouts live inside v2; classic v1 remains the default fallback. All v2 layouts retain the large time/date header without visible Overlook branding.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded artwork and clear remote focus.
dos: Do preserve the large time/date and artwork-led hierarchy across all v2 layouts.
Do keep focus outlines, hero text and app headings from overlapping or clipping.
Do use real provider content and owning-app fallback icons.
donts: Don't add visible Overlook branding to v2 home layouts.
Don't treat absent provider entries as permission to invent viewing history.
